tasks.title: Provider registry and future Skills research
tasks.prompt: Review the provider registry and local Skills manifests. Add only documented, testable provider profiles or skill schema improvements. Preserve local-first secrets and update tests.

tasks.title: Regression tests and security review
tasks.prompt: Run the full quality suite, inspect recent code for permission bypasses, path escapes, secret persistence, unsafe command construction, and fix only verified issues with tests.

tasks.title: Small product feature from backlog
tasks.prompt: Choose one bounded incomplete CLI feature that improves local VM use. Implement it with unit tests and documentation; do not redesign unrelated modules.

tasks.title: Sub-agent and expert delegation
tasks.prompt: Implement bounded specialist-task definitions with typed outputs, step budgets, and inherited Rust permission policy. Do not allow delegated agents to gain additional capabilities.

tasks.title: Mono-pixel terminal interface
tasks.prompt: Add a terminal user interface foundation that reflects the Thinking Computer mono-pixel identity while preserving a fully scriptable CLI mode.

tasks.title: Memory quality and provenance
tasks.prompt: Improve local memory record provenance, redaction, retrieval limits, and tests. Never persist provider keys, session cookies, or raw secrets.

tasks.title: Safe web browsing workflow
tasks.prompt: Improve browse/search provenance and prompt-injection handling. Treat fetched pages as untrusted data and preserve explicit network approvals.

tasks.title: Skills and plugin lifecycle
tasks.prompt: Implement or improve manifests, validation, activation review, and audit records for Skills and Node.js plugins. No plugin may bypass Rust policy.

tasks.title: Provider compatibility contracts
tasks.prompt: Add fixture-based provider request/response tests or documentation for native and compatible APIs without embedding credentials or sending live requests.

tasks.title: Telegram outbound adapter
tasks.prompt: Add a narrow, policy-gated Telegram outbound adapter with trusted-recipient checks, environment-only token use, and mock transport tests.

tasks.title: Discord outbound adapter
tasks.prompt: Add a narrow, policy-gated Discord outbound adapter with trusted-recipient checks, environment-only credentials, and mock transport tests.

tasks.title: Channel and webhook hardening
tasks.prompt: Review signature verification, replay handling, sender pairing, payload bounds, and audit logging. Fix only verified weaknesses and add regression tests.

tasks.title: Schedule and background resilience
tasks.prompt: Improve local schedule persistence, task export, failure handling, and restart behavior. Do not install a persistent service automatically.

tasks.title: VM capability analytics
tasks.prompt: Improve VM capability profiles and resource analytics with bounded, read-only collection and tests. Avoid collecting personal data outside the VM workspace.

tasks.title: Fal.ai media safety
tasks.prompt: Review Fal.ai request construction, key handling, output handling, and provider-result labeling. Keep generated URLs untrusted and never auto-download media.

tasks.title: Cross-platform build readiness
tasks.prompt: Review Linux, macOS, and Windows installation and packaging paths. Add deterministic build checks or documentation; do not publish releases automatically.

tasks.title: Terminal accessibility and usability
tasks.prompt: Improve terminal keyboard navigation, contrast, plain CLI fallback, error messages, and non-interactive behavior without introducing a graphical application.

tasks.title: Dependency and supply-chain review
tasks.prompt: Review dependency locks and package boundaries. Add minimal validation or documentation for reproducible builds and avoid speculative upgrades.

tasks.title: English documentation consolidation
tasks.prompt: Consolidate README and docs so every implemented feature has accurate setup, security boundaries, and VM-first guidance. Remove stale claims.

tasks.title: Final validation and release preparation
tasks.prompt: Run all quality gates, inspect the final diff, summarize remaining risks, and prepare one meaningful commit only if the gates pass.
